style: Production quality hand-painted naturalistic 2D pond game sprite, orthographic STRICT TOP DOWN dorsal view, fine brushwork with realistic anatomy, delicate surface texture and controlled highlights, same style as a premium painted koi pond game. Exactly ONE isolated subject centered and fully visible, generous transparent margin, true transparent alpha background, NO checkerboard, NO text, NO scenery, NO water, NO cast shadow. Head points to the RIGHT; tail points LEFT. Subject horizontal. Do not include any other objects.
